title: Branchy
description: Adds branches to the game, inspired by ContentSMP
body:
# Branchy
**Adds branches to the game, inspired by ContentSMP's [ContentContent](https://modrinth.com/mod/contentcontent) mod, and [Branched trees](https://modrinth.com/mod/branched-trees) mod by HearthianDev.**

![All branch variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/257d57ceb364e78750635be92bee9a15870e2fc1.png)

## Features:
- Branches for all 10 **vanila** wood types plus their stripped variants
- 1 extra wood type branches - Folly wood
- Branches connect in all 6 directions
- Right-click any branch with leaves to add foliage — supports all vanilla leaf types
- Right-click with an axe to strip branches
- Branches can be waterlogged
- Craft branches from a plank + 2 sticks (or qartz for Folly wood specificly)

## Basic idea of this mod
While watching [doctor4t](https://www.youtube.com/@doctor4t)'s decorating stream i noticed some funky branches they had, so I decided to make something similar for my preffered version of minecraft since nothing existed!
